items.informal_name: Partial Derivatives Commute with Ring Homomorphisms in Multivariate Polynomials
items.informal_description: For any commutative semiring $ S $, ring homomorphism $ \varphi : R \to S $, polynomial $ f \in R[\sigma] $, and variable $ i \in \sigma $, the partial derivative of $ \varphi(f) $ with respect to $ i $ equals $ \varphi $ applied to the partial derivative of $ f $ with respect to $ i $. Symbolically, $ \frac{\partial}{\partial i}(\varphi(f)) = \varphi\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial i}\right) $.

items.informal_name: Derivative of Mapped Polynomial Equals Mapped Derivative
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : R →+* S),
  Polynomial.derivativeFinsupp (Polynomial.map f p) =
    Finsupp.mapRange (fun x => Polynomial.map f x) ⋯ (Polynomial.derivativeFinsupp p)
items.informal_description: For any semirings $ R $ and $ S $, a ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $, and a polynomial $ p \in R[X] $, the derivative of the polynomial obtained by applying $ f $ to each coefficient of $ p $ is equal to the polynomial obtained by applying $ f $ to the derivative of $ p $. Symbolically: $ \mathrm{derivative}(\mathrm{map}_f(p)) = \mathrm{map}_f(\mathrm{derivative}(p)) $.

items.informal_name: Compatibility of Sum of Iterated Derivatives with Polynomial Coefficient Mapping
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : R →+* S),
  Polynomial.sumIDeriv (Polynomial.map f p) = Polynomial.map f (Polynomial.sumIDeriv p)
items.informal_description: For any semirings $ R $ and $ S $, ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $, and polynomial $ p \in R[X] $, the sum of iterated derivatives of the polynomial obtained by applying $ f $ to coefficients of $ p $ equals the polynomial obtained by applying $ f $ to coefficients of the sum of iterated derivatives of $ p $. Formally, $ \sum_{i=0}^\infty \frac{d^i}{dx^i}(p.map\,f) = \left(\sum_{i=0}^\infty \frac{d^i p}{dx^i}\right).map\,f $.

items.informal_name: Derivative of a Polynomial under Coefficient Mapping by a Ring Homomorphism
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : R →+* S),
  Polynomial.derivative (Polynomial.map f p) = Polynomial.map f (Polynomial.derivative p)
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p \in R[X] $ and any ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $, the derivative of the polynomial obtained by applying $ f $ to each coefficient of $ p $ is equal to the polynomial obtained by applying $ f $ to each coefficient of the derivative of $ p $. Formally, $ \frac{d}{dX}(p^f) = \left( \frac{d}{dX}p \right)^f $, where $ p^f $ denotes the polynomial with coefficients transformed by $ f $.

items.informal_name: Commutativity of Iterated Derivatives and Coefficient Mapping
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : R →+* S) (k : ℕ),
  (⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] (Polynomial.map f p) = Polynomial.map f ((⇑Polynomial.derivative)^[k] p)
items.informal_description: For any semiring $ S $, polynomial $ p $ over $ R $, ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $, and natural number $ k $, the $ k $-th derivative of the polynomial obtained by applying $ f $ to each coefficient of $ p $ is equal to the polynomial obtained by applying $ f $ to each coefficient of the $ k $-th derivative of $ p $. Symbolically, $ D^k(p^f) = (D^k p)^f $, where $ D^k $ denotes the $ k $-th derivative and $ p^f $ denotes the polynomial with coefficients mapped by $ f $.

items.informal_name: Compatibility of Partial Derivatives with Renaming in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] {τ : Type u_1} {f : σ → τ},
  Function.Injective f →
    ∀ (x : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
      (MvPolynomial.pderiv (f x)) ((MvPolynomial.rename f) p) = (MvPolynomial.rename f) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv x) p)
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a commutative semiring, $ \sigma, \tau $ be variable index sets, and $ f : \sigma \to \tau $ an injective map. For any polynomial $ p \in R[\sigma] $ and variable $ x \in \sigma $, the partial derivative operator commutes with renaming variables via $ f $: $ \frac{\partial}{\partial (f(x))} (p^f) = (\frac{\partial p}{\partial x})^f $, where $ p^f $ denotes the polynomial obtained by renaming variables according to $ f $.

items.informal_name: Coefficient Preservation under Ring Homomorphism in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] (f : R →+* S₁)
  (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (m : σ →₀ ℕ), MvPolynomial.coeff m ((MvPolynomial.map f) p) = f (MvPolynomial.coeff m p)
items.informal_description: For any multivariate polynomial $ p $ over a commutative semiring $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \sigma $, and for any monomial $ m : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $, the coefficient of $ m $ in the polynomial $ \text{map}(f)(p) $ (obtained by applying a ring homomorphism $ f : R \to S $ to the coefficients of $ p $) equals $ f $ applied to the coefficient of $ m $ in $ p $. In symbols: $ \text{coeff}_m(\text{map}(f)(p)) = f(\text{coeff}_m(p)) $.

items.informal_name: Compatibility of Jacobian Z-Polynomial with Ring Homomorphisms
items.type:
∀ {R : Type r} {S : Type s} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] {W' : WeierstrassCurve.Jacobian R} (f : R →+* S),
  (WeierstrassCurve.map W' f).toJacobian.polynomialZ = (MvPolynomial.map f) W'.polynomialZ
items.informal_description: For a Weierstrass curve $ W' $ over a ring $ A $, a ring homomorphism $ f : A \to B $, and the Jacobian polynomial $ Z $-derivative $ \partial_Z $, the $ Z $-polynomial of the Jacobian of the curve obtained by applying $ f $ to $ W' $'s coefficients equals the image of $ \partial_Z(W') $ under the evaluation homomorphism induced by $ f $. Formally, $ \partial_Z((W')_f) = f(\partial_Z(W')) $, where $ (W')_f $ denotes the curve with coefficients transformed by $ f $.
